basics.name: Kenneth Neal
basics.label: Lead Innovation Engineer
basics.summary: Lead Innovation Engineer at Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana with over a decade in infrastructure operations, database administration, and site reliability engineering. I'm the person Infrastructure and Operations comes to for technical decisions, from design tradeoffs to vendor picks. I built the batch job approval-and-execution platform I&O runs on, automated infrastructure monitoring and decommissioning with PowerShell and API integrations, and led HA/DR architecture for the company's core claims-processing systems. Outside of work, I'm President of Baton Rouge User Groups and chair the Baton Rouge SQL Saturday planning committee.

work.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana
work.summary: Promoted to Lead Innovation Engineer in March 2026, building on my SRE work for Infrastructure and Operations while using AI-assisted development to solve operational problems faster.
highlights: Still the go-to technical resource for I&O, weighing in on priorities and technical direction for management and other teams.
Prototype and ship internal applications with AI-assisted development tools, closing operational gaps for I&O and business partners quickly.
Own and continue building out the batch job approval-and-execution platform and infrastructure automation from the SRE role.

work.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana
work.summary: Senior technical resource for Infrastructure and Operations, driving improvements to monitoring, batch processing, and infrastructure automation across the estate.
highlights: Go-to technical expert for I&O, presenting priorities and technical options to management and cross-functional teams.
Built a custom ServiceNow application to govern batch job systems end-to-end, replacing manual approval and execution with automated, auditable API-driven workflows.
Worked hands-on with Control-M for batch job scheduling and SolarWinds/SCOM for infrastructure monitoring.
Automated the infrastructure deprovisioning process with PowerShell and API calls, cutting decommission turnaround by 99% and improving overall infrastructure hygiene.
Partnered with other teams to scope and plan automation projects that cut down on manual, repetitive work for I&O staff.

work.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana
work.summary: Designed and deployed SQL Server environments, keeping HA/DR requirements in check while automating upgrades to the company's main claims processing system.
highlights: Designed and deployed SQL Server environments, meeting HA/DR requirements and maintaining security, backup, and redundancy for critical claims infrastructure.
Monitored the SQL Server estate for health and performance, catching bottlenecks early and working with developers to fix them before users noticed.
Automated deployment and upgrades for the company's main claims processing system, cutting upgrade and refresh windows from hours to minutes to maximize uptime.
Automated deployment of a full DR environment for disaster recovery drills, validating recovery and redundancy procedures.
Worked across teams to streamline processes and handle internal customer requests, providing 2nd- and 3rd-level technical support.
Backed up the Oracle DBA.
Received multiple SPOT awards for going above and beyond for customers.

work.name: Amedisys
work.summary: Managed over 300 SQL Server instances, keeping critical databases performant and highly available.
highlights: Managed and monitored over 300 SQL Server instances across the estate.
Monitored production performance for bottlenecks and worked with other groups to fix issues before users were impacted.
Reviewed developer queries for performance before release to production.
Configured critical databases for high availability.

references.name: Ryan LeBlanc
references.reference: Kenny is invaluable to any team environment. He is able to communicate very well in any setting and excels in talking about technologies. He is able to keep up with today's technologies and collaborate with the team on solutions to problems that arise. He is an invaluable DBA to have and he is able to accomplish tasks very fast. Kenny is able to add a sense of light humor to the workplace that lightens the mood and makes it feel less like a 9 to 5 painful job and more like a down to earth enjoyable place to get stuff done and collaborate. His professionalism when it comes to getting things done is second to none.
